name: Mailman
source:
Two months after I started delivering mail, the disappearances began. What’s haunting this place?

[From [url=https://conceptualhenry.itch.io/mailman]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在我开始派送邮件两个月后，失踪事件接连发生。究竟是什么东西在暗中纠缠着这个地方？

[摘自[url=https://conceptualhenry.itch.io/mailman]itch.io[/url]]
